author: root Codex architecture and independent expected-state derivation before worker implementation
purpose: Small finite-state check of one permission-frontier/serialized-PTE cycle, not a throughput simulator or system deadlock proof
reason_for_new_small_component: The existing stage82 sender checker has no destination-permission frontier or PTE-after-RLAST dependency. Do not modify/re-run that old matrix. One minimal pure state graph is necessary for this different dependency, with six fixed cases only.
state: (r,w,p): r source words actually accepted0..N; w true destination words written0..r; p boolean second WRITE-region permission actually received. FIFO occupancy=r-w. Initial(0,0,false). Initial WRITE prefix0..C-1 and own source READ are already validated, retained and usable independently of the second translation.

transitions.R: Accept the next ordered source word if r<N and r-w<Q. full_prepare additionally requiresp=true. split_source blocks beyond r=C untilp=true, representing a PTE placed between first and second AR returns. frontier does not block atC. No same-event W-pop-to-R borrowing.
transitions.W: Write one true head iff w<r and (w<C orp=true). No unauthorized W, no dropped source data, no synthetic W.
transitions.PTE: Setp=true once, if false. full_prepare allows before source launch atinitialr0. split_source requiresr=C, whose first AR RLAST is actually accepted. frontier requiresr=N, whose original long AR RLAST is actually accepted. This is a legal worst-case shared serialized return service: a new PTE response cannot bypass that already selected AR's RLAST.
transitions.interleavings: Enumerate every distinct state reachable under every legal R/W/PTE event ordering. No idle self-edge; deadlock means nonterminal state has no progressing transition, not a finite service stall.

acceptance.invariants: Every reached state obeys0<=w<=r<=N,0<=r-w<=Q, and ifp=false thenw<=C. Every terminal hasr=w=N andp=true. Every edge changes precisely its named real event. No assumption that a future PTE succeeds before its actual grant.
acceptance.outputs: For each of six cases include states, legal edges, all nonterminal deadlocks, one shortest terminal witness or deadlock path and complete-event counts(sourceR=N/trueW=N for complete; READ AR1 frontier/full_prepare or2 split; two WRITE region preparations with one upfront frontier/split andtwo full_prepare). Save all reachable states/edges to enable independent root inspection.
acceptance.scope: No AXI AW owner simulation, child/debt scheduler, timeline/performance, faults/remap, unaligned masks, multiple AR or interleaved IDs. Physical prepared-prefix W is an explicit hypothesis. Test this dependency only, do not infer real system progress or latency.

root_independent_oracle.frontier_N8: Before tail grant: sum_{r=0..8}(min(r,5)-max(0,r-3)+1) where nonnegative =24 states. At r8 the only pregrant state isw5; grant permitsw5..8=4 postgrant states, total28. One terminal, zero nonterminal deadlocks.
root_independent_oracle.frontier_N9: Same24 pregrant states; r9 would requirew>=6 but unprepared permission forbidsw>5. Unique deadlock(r8,w5,pfalse), occupancy3, original RLAST still pending. Zero terminal states.
root_independent_oracle.full_N8: One initial pregrant state plus30 postgrant states (1+2+3+6*4). Total31, zero nonterminal deadlocks, one terminal.
root_independent_oracle.full_N9: One pregrant plus34 postgrant states (1+2+3+7*4). Total35, zero nonterminal deadlocks, one terminal.
root_independent_oracle.split_N8: 18 pregrant states throughr5; postgrant r5..8 each four possiblew,16 states. Total34, zero nonterminal deadlocks, one terminal.
root_independent_oracle.split_N9: 18 pregrant plus20 postgrant states. Total38, zero nonterminal deadlocks, one terminal.
